mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% in a month triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return discount, anticipating Fed rate hikes that reduce equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in a month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns do not deviate significantly from the pre-inflation spike mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS suggests growing labor market strength, which precedes S&P 500 forward returns over a 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: In regimes with high unemployment, 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in the HOUST industrial production series of at least 3 months signals weakening demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: During contraction phases, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production) accompanied by a simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (goods orders) indicates supply-side shock divergence, producing positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < GDPC1 by > 10% in a month
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward return when the interaction pattern is absent or reversed (Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 20 days due to persistent tight money.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained uptick in UNRATE (unemployment rate) above 4% for a month is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days due to risk-off sentiment.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% in a month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative in > 70% of such regimes (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (industrial production) above their 2020 Q4 averages for 10 days predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: Both RSAFS > 2020-Q4 avg and HOUST > 2020-Q4 avg for 10 days
failure_condition: Interaction not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or 20-day returns not positive when trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to a supply deficit where INDPRO growth lags behind GDP growth (approximated via GDPC1) for 3 consecutive months predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth < GDPC1 growth for 3 months
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward return when the supply gap pattern is absent (Granger causality rejected).
